description_for_human: Pipeline, accounts, renewals, overdue invoices, SLA-risk cases and new leads from Brillienta CRM.
description_for_model: Render live Brillienta CRM data in the Copilot canvas with six tools: GetMyPipeline, GetAccountSummary, GetRenewals, GetOverdueInvoices, GetSlaRiskCases and CreateLead. Data comes from the customer's own SharePoint site with the signed-in user's permissions. Select the single narrowest tool from its description. Prompt values only filter a view or prefill the lead form; nothing is created or changed unless the user presses Save in the form.
